title: Job
description: Persisted state for one video job - a transcript plus slide PDF, or (inputMode 'notes') a PPTX's speaker notes plus that deck's PDF export. Stored as the `data` JSON column of one row in the `jobs` MySQL table (see backend/schema.sql) and treated as the single source of truth for backend/worker.py and the UI's status polling.

phase.description: Coarse pipeline phase. 'prepare' covers alignment against the full transcript/slide deck plus narration cleaning (filler and personal references removed - no duration budget applied, never touched again after this). 'ready_for_review' is both the human-reviewable slide+text checkpoint prepare stops at AND the job's permanent resting state afterward - a job can sit here indefinitely, spawning any number of 'shorts' (see below). 'condensing'/'editing'/'rendering' mean whichever short is named by activeShortId is currently mid-pipeline; the job always returns to 'ready_for_review' once that short finishes or fails, regardless of the short's own outcome. 'ready_for_render'/'done' are legacy values from before shorts existed (a job itself is never rendered directly anymore) and are only expected on jobs created before this change.

inputMode.description: 'transcript': an .srt aligned to the slide PDF by Claude, then cleaned (the original flow). 'notes': a PPTX whose speaker notes are the narration, plus the PDF export of that same deck for the images; prepare pairs visible slide i with page i and writes narration verbatim - no alignment, no cleaning, no Claude call. 'recording': a Zoom recording of the presentation (sources.recording): a Fargate ingest task finds the slides in the video and pulls their frames and the audio; the transcript is the uploaded Zoom WebVTT or ElevenLabs speech-to-text; one Claude call trims the recording to the talk; alignment is by time (each slide takes what was said while it was on screen), then cleaning and outlining as in transcript mode. Absent on jobs created before the mode existed, which are 'transcript'.

activeShortId.description: Set to a shorts[].shortId while that short is mid-pipeline (phase='condensing' or 'rendering' above names which one); null the rest of the time. Only one short per job may be in flight at once - POST /jobs/<id>/shorts and .../shorts/<shortId>/render both reject a new request with this already set.

step.description: Fine-grained step within the current phase, for UI progress display.

params.description: Everything the UI submits at job creation. Immutable for phase 1. Duration/voice moved to per-short fields (see shorts[]) since condensing is no longer a one-shot job-level step.

narrationStyle.description: Free-text tone/expertise instruction for clean_narration's style-neutral cleaning pass only, e.g. 'explain like a park ranger, plain language' or 'academic hydrology lecture'. Not used by shorts - those always use the hardcoded CBT/MI/ACT/DBT prompt (see pipeline.SHORT_NARRATION_PROMPT_NAME).

minSlideSeconds.description: Floor on how long a slide is held even if its narration audio is shorter than this.

srt.description: null in notes mode. In recording mode, filled during 'transcribing' with the SRT written from the Zoom VTT or speech-to-text (path under the job's input dir), so the rest of the app sees a transcript.

pptx.description: Notes mode only (null otherwise): the uploaded deck. The counts are filled in during 'extracting_notes' for the review UI.

slideCount.description: All slides in the PPTX, hidden included.

hiddenCount.description: Hidden slides, skipped - PowerPoint leaves them out of the PDF export too.

narratedCount.description: Visible slides that had speaker notes or an embedded video and so became narration segments.

videoCount.description: Visible slides carrying an embedded video (see slides[].video).

slidesWithoutNotes.description: slideIds of visible slides with empty notes and no video - left out of job.narration, so no short can pick them.

recording.description: Recording mode only (null otherwise). Set at creation (filename, s3Key, sizeBytes, vtt), extended by the worker as ingest, transcription and trim complete.

s3Key.description: Where the browser's direct-to-S3 upload landed (uploads/<id>/<name>.mp4). The ingest task deletes it after a successful ingest (sourceDeleted).

vtt.description: The Zoom WebVTT transcript if one was uploaded; otherwise speech-to-text runs over the audio parts.

thumbnailBox.description: [left, top, width, height] of the speaker thumbnail as fractions of the frame, filled in from the surrounding background on every slide frame.

timeline.description: render/ingest.py's segments in time order: what was on screen when. Slide segments carry the frame files (under data/jobs/<id>/ingest/slides/) that became job.slides entries 'rec-s<index>'.

audio.description: Mono MP3 parts of the soundtrack from audioStartSeconds on, each up to 20 min, what speech-to-text was run on.

trim.description: The span of the recording that is the presentation. Alignment covers only slide segments inside it and not in excludedSegments. PATCH /jobs/<id>/trim replaces it and re-runs alignment + cleaning.

excludedSegments.description: timeline[].index values inside the span to leave out (a break, an interruption).

pdfs.description: Exactly one entry must have role='primary' (notes mode: exactly one PDF, the deck's export; recording mode: empty). UI enforces this with a radio control; a single uploaded PDF is auto-assigned primary.

order.description: User-set drag order among multiple PDFs; primary need not be order 0.

slides.description: Flattened, ordered-by-extraction list of every page across every PDF (pre-alignment). Populated during 'extracting_pdfs'. Recording mode: one entry per detected slide segment instead ('rec-s<index>', pdfId 'recording', pageNumber counting up), populated during 'fetching_ingest', whatever the trim.

imagePath.description: Full-resolution rendition: the page rasterised so its long edge is SLIDE_IMAGE_LONG_EDGE_PX (3840 by default). What the render uses; only the slides a short's script references are ever uploaded to S3.

previewImagePath.description: Small rendition (long edge SLIDE_PREVIEW_LONG_EDGE_PX, 1280 by default) the review UI loads instead of imagePath. Absent on jobs prepared before it existed - the UI falls back to imagePath.

textPath.description: Extracted page text, given to the alignment model alongside the image itself. null for a recording's frames.

recordingSegment.description: Recording mode only: which timeline segment this frame came from and when it was on screen.

video.description: Notes mode only: the first video embedded on this slide in the PPTX (the PDF export carries nothing of it but a blank), written to data/jobs/<id>/media/. The render composites it over the slide image at `box` after the segment's narration (or alone on a video-only slide, whose narration script is empty), played once, its own sound mixed in, last frame held if narration + clip is shorter than minSlideSeconds. Dropped if the segment's image is swapped post-review.

durationSeconds.description: From the MP4 container at intake; null for other containers (the render reads the real length).

transcript.description: What the clip says (ElevenLabs speech-to-text at intake) - the only thing the app knows about the clip's content; build_short shows it to Claude. null if transcription failed or the clip has no speech.

box.description: [left, top, width, height] as fractions of the slide.

imageAudit.description: Effective resolution of the bitmaps embedded on this page (pixel size over placed size, fills of 8 px or under ignored), measured at intake. minEffectivePpi below requiredPpi means a full-size render upscales that image; the review UI flags it. Vector content is not audited - it is rasterised at whatever DPI we choose.

requiredPpi.description: What OUTPUT_MAX_WIDTH_PX x OUTPUT_MAX_HEIGHT_PX (1920x1080) demands of this page's geometry.

alignment.description: Claude's alignment output (backend/alignment.py): which slide was on screen for which stretch of the transcript, in transcript order. The model cites cue ranges; transcriptExcerpt is sliced from the SRT itself, never model-written text. Populated during 'aligning'.

startCue.description: 0-based index into the SRT's cues, inclusive.

endCue.description: 0-based index into the SRT's cues, inclusive.

notes.description: The model's one-phrase rationale, kept for the human review UI, e.g. 'chart matches narration about flow rates'.

title.description: The presentation's title, at most 8 words, from pipeline.outline_subtopics (the last prepare step). Shown above the review list.

subtopics.description: The distinct sub-topics the talk covers, from one Claude call over the whole narration at the end of prepare (step 'outlining'), in presentation order. The Create-short form offers these so staff need not know the deck: choosing one fills the topic box with `brief` and the length with `suggestedDurationSeconds`. Empty (with subtopicsError set) if the outline failed - a warning, never a failed prepare - and absent on jobs prepared before the step existed.

brief.description: One sentence: what a viewer would learn. Used verbatim as a short's topic/brief when picked.

slideIds.description: The narration slides this sub-topic spans, in order; validated against job.narration.

wordCount.description: Total narration words across slideIds - computed, not model-estimated.

suggestedDurationSeconds.description: The longest offered length (pipeline.DURATION_OPTIONS) that wordCount fills at WORDS_PER_MINUTE.

subtopicsError.description: Why the outline step produced nothing, when it failed.

subtopicsReused.description: True when the narration's fingerprint matched an earlier job's and its outline was reused from DATA_DIR/outline-cache.json instead of regenerated - so an identical deck gets identical sub-topics.

narration.description: Populated once: during 'cleaning_narration' from job.alignment's raw excerpts (kept untouched alongside this, so cleaning is never irreversible), or in notes mode during 'extracting_notes' straight from the PPTX's speaker notes, verbatim, with job.alignment left empty - full-length, cleaned of filler/personal references, not sized to any duration. Permanent for the life of the job: nothing after this point ever mutates it. This is the 1:1 slide-to-narration pool every short (below) is built from.

script.description: Empty for a video-only slide in notes mode: the clip plays alone, no narration is synthesized.

shorts.description: Independently created, duration-targeted condensed narratives built from job.narration. Each is created via POST /jobs/<id>/shorts and reflects a single coherent script (not a per-slide shrink of the 1:1 narration) grounded in a subset of the original slides, then voiced and rendered on its own via POST /jobs/<id>/shorts/<shortId>/render - a job can hold any number of these (e.g. a 90s teaser and a 5-minute full summary from the same prepared job).

topic.description: Required. What this short is about, e.g. 'full presentation overview' or 'the wastewater treatment section' - the only way to tell shorts on the same job apart, so it's mandatory rather than optional.

name.description: The video's name, at most 8 words, written by build_short alongside the script (falls back to topic). Used for the card header, the download filename, and the first title card.

subtopic.description: The job.subtopics entry this short was started from, if any, frozen at creation time (id, title, slideIds). build_short restricts the source material to slideIds (widened with deck neighbours only when fewer than the pacing needs) and names the sub-topic in the brief - so the same choice yields the same slide set.

sourceSlides.description: What build_short was given: core (the sub-topic's slides, or the whole deck for a free topic) and supporting (neighbours added, in deck order, to reach target/SECONDS_PER_SLIDE distinct slides).

lengthCheck.description: build_short's check of the draft against the brief: estimated spoken length (words at WORDS_PER_MINUTE plus any clip) vs target, distinct slides vs the pacing target (one per SECONDS_PER_SLIDE), per-segment cap (HARD_MAX_SEGMENT_SECONDS). A miss triggers one revision pass; 'revised' says whether it was taken, 'remainingProblems' what still misses. Shown on the card before any audio or render is spent.

prompt.description: The narration_prompts entry build_short writes this short with, chosen in the Create-short form. id null means the short predates that picker and build_short falls back to the library entry named pipeline.SHORT_NARRATION_PROMPT_NAME.

provider.description: Which speech API synthesizes this short. Absent on shorts created before the field existed, meaning elevenlabs. xai (Grok) supports mode=preset only, with presetVoiceId one of pipeline.XAI_VOICES (eve, liora, ara).

presetVoiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice_id from the curated dropdown, or an xAI voice id when provider=xai. Required when mode=preset.

customDescription.description: Freeform voice description for ElevenLabs Voice Design. Required when mode=custom.

resolvedVoiceId.description: Filled in during 'resolving_voice'. Cached in data/voice-cache.json for mode=custom.

phase.description: This short's own state machine, independent of every other short on the job and of job.phase itself. 'editing' means a post-review text edit or a newly added segment is waiting on the next cron tick to (re)synthesize its audio (see pendingSegments) - every other segment's audio is untouched.

pendingSegments.description: Transient - sequenceIndex values in script[] awaiting (re)synthesis, set by a text edit or a new segment and consumed by worker.run_edit_pipeline. Empty/absent outside phase='editing'.

script.description: Populated by pipeline.build_short() from the full job.narration pool - one coherent narrative Claude wrote to the target word budget, broken into segments each grounded in an original slideId (a subset of job.narration's slides; several may be merged under one, most may be dropped). Every slideId here is guaranteed to exist in job.narration. Editable after review: sequenceIndex stays contiguous (0..N-1) across edits/deletes/inserts.

slideId.description: Which job.slides entry this segment is nominally grounded in. Null for a segment added post-review with no corresponding original slide. Ignored for rendering when customImagePath is set, but kept for lineage.

title.description: Title-card text for this segment, at most 6 words, written by build_short (an added segment gets whatever the form supplied, possibly empty). Editable via PATCH .../segments/<seq> with {title} alone, which needs no resynthesis. Shown by the render when the short was rendered with the titleCards override; empty means no card for this segment. The first segment's card shows the short's name instead.

customImagePath.description: Set when this segment's image was replaced with an upload (not one of job.slides' own images) or added post-review. Takes priority over resolving slideId for rendering. Null means use job.slides[slideId]'s image as normal. May be null on an added segment that has only a customVideoPath.

customVideoPath.description: An uploaded clip on a segment added post-review (data/jobs/<id>/shorts/<shortId>/custom-media/). The render plays it full-frame (letterboxed, over customImagePath if there is one, else black) after the segment's narration, or alone when script is empty, with its own sound; its length is added to estimatedSeconds.

customVideoSeconds.description: customVideoPath's length from its container, for the UI and estimates.

videoSlidesWithheld.description: Set by build_short: slideIds whose embedded clip exceeds MAX_VIDEO_SHARE (half) of this short's target length and were therefore not offered to Claude at all - a short is never shorter than a clip it contains, and a clip is never most of a short. Shown on the short's card.

audio.description: One synthesized clip per short.script segment, in the same order. Populated during 'synthesizing_audio'.

render.description: This short's own render state - independent of every other short's. pendingOverrides (set by POST .../render, consumed by dispatch) may carry type/transitionSeconds/minSlideSeconds/resolution, includeIntro, includeOutro, and titleCards (each segment opens on its title card - white on black over the first 2.5 s while the narration already plays, crossfaded into the slide; adds no time unless a segment is shorter than card + minSlideSeconds).

outputUrl.description: Presigned S3 GET URL written by worker.run_render at completion (valid one hour). GET /jobs/<id>/status re-signs it (and each history entry's) on every read via fargate_client.refresh_output_urls, so the UI never sees an expired link; the stored value is only the marker that a finished render exists. Cleared by POST .../render so a stale preview disappears immediately.

renderCount.description: Monotonic across the short's life - never reset, so a replacement render's video-NN.mp4 never shares a name with the one being deleted.

staleRenderCount.description: Transient - set by POST .../render when a previous render exists (its outputUrl/renderedAt are cleared at the same time, so the UI stops showing it immediately). Consumed by worker.run_render on dispatch, which deletes that render's video from S3 and drops its history entry. A re-render replaces the previous render rather than accumulating beside it.

staleDeleteError.description: Diagnostic only - set when deleting a superseded render's video from S3 failed (the new render proceeds regardless). Cleared on the next successful delete. Almost always means the IAM policy lacks s3:DeleteObject on the render bucket.

history.description: Renders whose video still exists. A superseded render's entry is removed when its video is deleted on the next re-render.

manus.description: Legacy - only present on jobs aligned by the earlier Manus-based pipeline. New jobs do not write it.
